text: 港股今日整体高开低走，恒指早盘升穿26000点后一路下挫，午后跌势难止，最低跌近300点报25647.66点。截至收盘，恒指收跌1.1%，报25652.82点，科指收跌1.93%，报4824.42点，恒指大市成交额达2109.42亿港元（上一交易日为2402.8亿港元）。盘面上，油气股全天表现强势，创新药概念午后冲高回落，有色金属板块全天承压明显，领跌大盘，新消费概念、商业航天、汽车、军工等板块跌幅居前。个股方面，中国海洋石油(00883.HK)收涨3.59%，再鼎医药(09688.HK)收涨5.28%，老铺黄金(06181.HK)收跌8.49%，紫金矿
text_en: Hong Kong stocks opened high and moved lower overall today. The Hang Seng Index rose above 26,000 points in early trading before declining continuously, with losses difficult to halt in the afternoon, falling nearly 300 points to 25,647.66 at the low. At close, the Hang Seng Index fell 1.1% to 25,652.82 points, the Tech Index fell 1.93% to 4,824.42 points, and the Hang Seng main board turnover reached HK$210.942 billion (versus HK$240.28 billion the previous trading day). On the market, oil and gas stocks remained strong throughout the day, innovative drug concepts surged then retreated in the afternoon, and non-ferrous metals sectors faced significant pressure all day, leading the market decline. New consumption concepts, commercial aerospace, autos, and military sectors fell notably.
